provenance: USDA PLANTS culturally significant plant inventory joined to exact USDA PlantSearch symbols and PlantProfile records. Only accepted species with an L48 Native profile status, a recognized growth habit, and a USDA plant-guide URL are included as candidate seed-start plants. L48 status and inventory membership are candidate-selection metadata, not local county nativity evidence; county claims are imported separately from the USDA PLANTS Counties layer.
